before: "I know you're in there. I love you. You don't have to love me back or trust me yet. I can't promise that nothing painful will happen. Or that I'll always know what to do, or never react badly. But I can promise to tell you the truth and listen when you're angry. I'll make our life together safer where I can, and take the next step I can see to protect you. When I fail, I'll come back to make it right. You don't have to believe these words. Watch what I do."
after: (Not written yet. The next paragraph: your little one may still answer "Big fuckity whoopty doo." That's allowed. Pick one thing small enough to repeat, because a vow gets believed through repeats, not one beautiful session. Don't say any of that here.)
brief:
- the guide, of the vow's "I love you": "Use 'I love you' only when it is honest." Say that part only if you mean it.
- the guide: "Otherwise, use a sincere wish for wellbeing or a commitment to non-cruelty". The article already has the wish, in "A Smaller Doorway: Goodwill": the Buddha's "May you be loving, peaceful, and free", and "if 'I love you' goes flat when you aim it at yourself or your little one, the same wish works there, too." Point back to it in a few words; don't teach it again. The other option is a plain promise not to be cruel to them.
- the guide: "without pretending they feel the same": the stand-in isn't the same as love, and you don't pretend it is.
- Don't repeat the vow or explain it.
length: one to three sentences, 25 to 60 words
guide_passage: Use “I love you” only when it is honest. Otherwise, use a sincere wish for wellbeing or a commitment to non-cruelty without pretending they feel the same.
next: Trust may still answer, “Big whoop.” That is allowed. Choose one response small enough to repeat. It may be practical—keeping an appointment, ending an unsafe exchange, eating, sleeping, or handling one neglected task—or relational: listening without retaliation, admitting where the complaint is true, or repairing after you attack yourself. The vow becomes credible through repetition, not one beautiful session.
